content.text: Register doesn't pass provider, so the default applies.

candidates.explanation: When no provider is supplied, the user's provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of AuthProvidersEnum.email. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then rejects them with `needLoginViaProvider:google`.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email.
